name: probe: does the current emulator user already have a drafted team (explains draft-5-picks-rarest failing)
description: draft-5-picks-rarest failed on FTUE-only selectors (.draft-start-btn, .draft-coach, .da-btn.primary.big). Those only render for a user with no team and unspent picks. This records the current user and whether a roster is present, so the failure can be attributed to user state rather than guessed at.
